label: Whatever is corruptible simply is in POTENCY_1 in some respect
paraphrase: OPEN bridge, analyst formulation, attribution deferred: whatever can fail to be in substance (corruptible simply) is in POTENCY_1 (the adopted potency in the subject: able to be r and not in act of r) in at least one respect, any respect. Not at esse in particular: POTENCY_1 at esse is incompatible with actual existence (R2 law). The existing B4b (what can fail to be in substance is in POTENCY_1 as to esse) implies it (controls, law 8). It passes from simple corruptibility to a potency in some respect, the direction DISAMB-CORRUPTIBLE-SIMPLY-OR-IN-A-RESPECT does not forbid.
